title: Finding basis
description: The answers a reviewer records for one finding. The field review_class of the finding file or register line picks the shape: the consequence tree for document, code, and runtime, the bug bar for security, and the matrix for architecture. The rule of the class computes the severity from these answers (validation-rules.md BR-081 to BR-083). schema-validate supports no oneOf, so each register schema in packages/factory/rulebooks/schemas/ inlines the one shape of its class.

in_use.description: true when something outside the current playbook run depends on the artifact. finding-lint checks it against git for code and runtime findings.

harms_downstream.description: true when the finding causes a wrong result, data loss, a security breach, or a broken contract, and the artifact is in use. true only when in_use is true.

fails_purpose.description: true when the reviewed artifact fails the job it exists for.

raises_cost.description: true when the artifact works, but the finding makes later reading, change, or testing harder.

effect.description: What the attacker gains. The effect class sets the starting level.

second_breach.description: true when the attack needs another compromise first.

trusted_access.description: true when the attack needs a local shell, write access to the repository, or an account in the project.

non_default.description: true when the attack needs a configuration or an opt-in feature that the Factory does not enable by default.

user_action.description: true when the attack needs the user to do something unusual.

confidence.description: proven when the attack path is reproduced or traced from the input to the sink in the code; plausible otherwise.

in_use.description: true when the vulnerable code is in use. finding-lint checks it against git.

importance.description: The importance of the threatened quality scenario. Priority 1 in arc42 section 10.2 is high, priority 2 is medium.

exposure.description: fails when the analysis shows the decision cannot meet the response measure of the scenario; uncertain when no evidence exists either way.

in_use.description: true when something built from the decision is in use. It raises a major risk to critical.
